senses.gloss:
नु ind.
1 A particle having an
interrogative force and implying
some ‘doubt’, or ‘uncertainty’;
स्वप्नो नु माया नु मतिभ्रमो नु Ś. 6. 9;
अस्तशैलगहनं नु विवस्वानाविवेश जलधिं
नु महीं नु Ki. 9. 7; 5. 1; 8. 53,
9. 15, 54; 13. 4; Ku. 1. 46;
Śi. 10. 14; Ś. 2. 9.
--2 It is very often
compounded with the interrogative
pronoun and its derivatives in the sense
of ‘possibly’, ‘indeed’; किं
न्वेतत्स्यात्किमन्यदितोऽथवा Māl. 1. 17; कथंनु
[]
गुणवद्विंदेयं कलत्रं Dk; see किंनु also.
--3
Ved. Now, even now.
--4 Now
therefore, now then, therefore.
--5 Like,
as.
--6 Quickly.
--7 From this time
forward.

नु {c2c} P. (नौति, प्रणौति; नुत; caus.
नावयति; desid. नुनूषति)
1 To praise,
extol, commend; सरस्वती तन्मिथुनं
नुनाव Ku. 7. 90; Bk. 14. 112; see नू.
--2 To roar, cry.
--3 To sound, shout.
II. {c1c} A. (नवते) To go.
नू {c6c} P. (नुवति) To praise &c.; see नु.
